name: video-timeline-model
title: Video timeline model
description: The model behind VideoTimeline: tracks of clips (source in/out, speed, volume, fades, dissolves, picture-in-picture frames, colour looks), a magnetic main track whose edits ripple, and pure edits (split, trim, move, insert, remove, slice, snap) that return a new timeline, plus timecode and the looks as CSS and FFmpeg filters.
